items.title: CFTC seeks to define event contracts as swaps amid prediction market fight
items.snippet: The classification could assist the CFTC’s claim that it has exclusive federal jurisdiction over event contracts offered on regulated prediction markets.
items.note: Негативний тон для загального ринку за ключовими словами -- варто звернути увагу.

items.title: MetaMask exits Ethereum validators amid undisclosed security incident
items.snippet: MetaMask said it is investigating the threat internally and said it has found no immediate threat to its wallets.
items.note: Нейтрально щодо ETH -- прямого сигналу на ціну за ключовими словами не видно.
